exception_title: Joint vs Waiver Filing Path Not Elected
exception_description: Applicant checks neither joint petition nor waiver basis; system accepts incomplete form without requiring election.
Waiver based on divorce: marriage termination date entered after I-751 filing date; circular date logic not caught.
Window opens 90 days before 2-year card expiry; system uses card issue date instead of expiry date as anchor.
Joint petition co-signed by person other than original sponsoring spouse; identity not verified against A-file.
I-751 VAWA waiver filed; system does not require contemporaneous evidence; waiver granted on declaration alone.
Card expiry MM/YY OCR'd with month and year swapped; 90-day window computed from wrong date.
Conditional resident files I-751 while separate I-485 (different basis) pending; dual-path conflict not flagged.
LLM rates evidence package as sufficient based on photo volume; does not check for joint financial-account evidence.

exception_title: I-751 Filed After Removal Proceedings Start
exception_description: Conditional resident in removal proceedings files I-751; USCIS accepts without EOIR jurisdiction check.
I-751 receipt notice should trigger 18-month (or 24-month) automatic extension on 2-year card; stamp not generated.
18-month extension stamp issued; stamp validity straddles fiscal year; I-9 reverification date computed incorrectly.
Joint petitioning spouse has domestic violence arrest record; no cross-check against law enforcement database.
LLM cannot reliably assess marriage bona fides when couple married abroad and evidence is entirely foreign-language.
Firm submits 50 I-751 petitions; batch processing associates wrong spouse's biometrics with each petition.
Approved I-751 issues 10-year card; prior 2-year card not revoked in USCIS card-validity database.
